title: Single Match Tickets
subtitle: Experience Rose City FC live at Robinson Stadium
transitSubtitle: Watch Rose City FC live and save on gas
directionsBody:
Watching Rose City FC games at Robinson Stadium is easy to reach by Foothill Transit.
Take Line 187 to Colorado Blvd and Sierra Bonita Ave E
Line 187 to Colorado Blvd and Sierra Bonita Ave E drops you off in front of Pasadena City College.
The stadium is about a 5-minute walk from the bus stop.
parkingBody: You may purchase daily parking permits for $2.00 a day from the yellow parking permit machines located on every level of the parking lots throughout the main and CEC campuses. All daily parking permit machines accept $1 bills.
parkingNote: *Parking Lot No 5 is on S Bonnie Ave
